integrity.proof_scope: Finite-N exact formula, infinite-N coefficient, sharp attainable reset-clock envelope, protocol-independent ratio law
integrity.verification: Analytic arguments supplemented by finite deterministic numerical tests; tests do not certify an infinite theorem

scientific_limitations: Stationary renewal clock with positive iid intervals and finite second moment
Free planar isotropic Brownian particles with one simultaneous whole-system reset, no additional individual resets
Pearson statistic is for the two coordinatewise maxima of the same cloud; not radial extrema or gap statistics
Gaussian-maxima asymptotics and conditional Gaussian mixture are established prerequisites; no independent scientific verification
title: A sharp reset-clock envelope for orthogonal extreme fronts in a planar Brownian gas
